One file in. One beautiful page out.

This page was generated by the actual Python engine at build time — the same code path as glowmark doc.md. There is no JavaScript imitation here.

Everything you need

  1. Point glowmark at a file.

    glowmark notes.md --out notes.html

  2. Or keep a live preview open while you write.

    glowmark --serve notes.md

GFM that behaves like GitHub

Feature Supported Notes
Tables ✅ GFM pipe tables
Task lists ✅ Real checkboxes
Footnotes ✅ With backlinks
Nested code ✅ Fences inside list items
  • CommonMark parsing
  • GitHub-style alerts
  • Take over the world

Tip

Edit the source file and run glowmark --serve — the browser refreshes itself. No build step, no account, no network for the core page.

Unicode is safe

Em dash —, arrow →, μ-law, café, naïve, 東京, ✨. Bytes are decoded as UTF-8, with BOMs and CRLF handled before the renderer sees them.
